tapeLine: Latest sourced close is Wednesday 14 October, after a hotter-than-expected September CPI: S&P 500 -1.1% to 7,718.94 (worst day since July), Nasdaq -1.9% to 26,692.87, Dow -0.1% to 51,621.48, per AP via Yahoo Finance and BBN Times. No Thursday futures were found.
matters:
Wednesday's September CPI rose 0.6% on the month and 3.7% on the year against 3.6% expected and 3.4% in August; core rose 0.3% on the month and 2.6% on the year, per the BLS release as reported by CNBC (14 Oct). Gasoline rose 9.1% on the month and made up over half of the headline increase.

Stocks fell on it, led by AI and chip names: the S&P 500 closed at 7,718.94, down 86.51 points from Tuesday's 7,805.45, its fifth loss in six sessions since the record, per AP (14 Oct). Several outlets framed the print as reviving Federal Reserve rate-hike bets; no sourced odds were found.

Invalidation: whether Thursday's PPI and retail sales confirm the energy-led price pressure, and whether the S&P 500 recovers Friday's 7,811.54 record close.
alsoOnTape: Oil, gold and Treasury yield levels for Wednesday were not found with a dated source and are not carried.
overnight: Latest confirmed close — Wednesday 14 October: S&P 500 -1.1% to 7,718.94, Nasdaq -1.9% to 26,692.87, Dow -0.1% to 51,621.48, per AP via Yahoo Finance. Thursday futures not found.
macro: Data — September CPI (14 Oct): +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y vs 3.6% expected; core 2.6% y/y vs 2.5% expected, per CNBC and BLS. PPI, retail sales and jobless claims are due Thursday, per Investinglive.

Earnings — Tuesday: Goldman Sachs reported diluted EPS $17.01 vs $13.65 consensus and revenue $18.68bn vs $17.03bn, per 247WallSt (13 Oct). JPMorgan shares were little changed; its figures were not found. Wells Fargo fell about 3%. Bank of America's weak results were cited as a Wednesday drag, per Yahoo Finance.
flow: Breadth, dealer gamma, put-call and skew are paid data and are not on this page.

regime.tag: Indexes broke lower Wednesday: S&P 500 -1.1% after five sessions within about 0.1% of the record.
regime.sizing: PPI and retail sales Thursday, then the 27-28 October FOMC, are the next scheduled evidence.

secondOrder: An energy-driven inflation surprise hit the AI and chip-heavy Nasdaq hardest, while the Dow barely moved. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: The prior regime read, that indexes held within 0.1% of record levels, broke on Wednesday: the S&P 500 fell 1.1% to 7,718.94 after CPI, per AP. It held through Tuesday (7,805.45) only.
The prior invalidation level held: the S&P 500 did not close above Friday's 7,811.54 on Tuesday (7,805.45) or Wednesday, per AP.
CPI was flagged as the next scheduled evidence and it moved the market: 3.7% y/y vs 3.6% expected, per CNBC.
Whether yields kept rising into CPI cannot be graded: no sourced Tuesday or Wednesday yield level was found.
The 27-28 October FOMC has not occurred.
